articles.title: Doug Morrison obituary
articles.summary: My friend and colleague Doug Morrison, who has died aged 83 from Parkinson’s-related pneumonia, was one of the Guardian’s key production journalists from the 1980s until the 2000s. He was a workmate revered for cool leadership under testing circumstances, not least during many technological changes and redesigns. He also wrote articles against apartheid while living…

articles.title: Stella Cherfas obituary
articles.summary: My friend Stella Cherfas, who has died aged 101, helped popularise yoga in Britain through her classes that spanned several decades. She was a well-known fixture in many of London’s community spaces, notably teaching free weekly classes at Covent Garden Community Centre’s Seven Dials Club. articles.title: Relocation of Cape Town baboons to sanctuary ignites heated protests
